# jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro VPP invitation by ID or name. Exactly one selector must be supplied.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `read:pro:vpp-invitations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation" "by_id" {
  id = "2"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation" "by_name" {
  name = "Volume Purchasing Self Service"
}

output "vpp_invitation_distribution_method" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_vpp_invitation.by_name.distribution_method
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Invitation ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Invitation name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `auto_register_managed_users` (Boolean) Auto-register Managed Apple ID users.
- `distribution_method` (String) Distribution method.
- `invitation_usages` (Attributes List) Read-only per-user registration status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invitation_usages))
- `message` (String) Email message (email mode).
- `require_login` (Boolean) Require login (email mode).
- `scope` (Attributes) User-based scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `sender_email_address` (String) Sender email address (email mode).
- `sender_name` (String) Sender display name (email mode).
- `subject` (String) Email subject (email mode).
- `vpp_account_id` (String) VPP account ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--invitation_usages"></a>

Read-Only:

- `email_address` (String) User email address.
- `id` (String) Usage record ID.

- `last_action_date_utc` (String) Last action timestamp (UTC).
- `name` (String) User name.
- `status` (String) Registration status.
- `vpp_account` (String) VPP account name.
